name: cosmic-req
description: COSMIC requirements analysis for one plan function: functional description, system-level functional users with user stories, and business rules (consumes a green cosmic-plan artifact).

functionalUserRoles.description: Comma-separated allowlist of system-level functional user roles (rule req/functional-user-roles); override per deployment

funcDescMaxLength.description: Maximum functional description length in characters (rule req/func-desc-max-length; the schema hard ceiling is 2000)

cfpsPerRule.description: CFP budget per business rule when sizing the businessRules array (rule req/business-rule-count)

cfpPerFunc.description: Per-function CFP budget {value, min, max}; inherited from the upstream receipt and re-recorded for the chain

cfpTotal.description: Total CFP budget {value, downFactor, upFactor}; the chain head states it, downstream stages inherit it from the upstream receipt

cfpPerSubProc.description: Average CFP per data movement; sizing guidance carried down the chain
